title: Layoff Runway Rebuild Coach
oneLiner: A career turnaround planner that helps recently laid-off professionals convert severance, savings, and skill gaps into a week-by-week rebound plan instead of panic scrolling job boards.
targetUser: White-collar professionals within the first 60 days after a layoff who need a structured comeback plan.
keyUX: See financial runway, pick a rebound path, and turn scattered anxiety into a weekly operating plan across applications, networking, learning, and cash preservation.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop career turnaround planner called Layoff Runway Rebuild Coach for recently laid-off professionals who need structure fast. It should help users understand financial runway, choose a realistic rebound path, and convert fear into a weekly plan for applications, networking, skill-building, and spending control. Include a runway and pressure summary, a rebound path selector, a weekly execution board, a network outreach tracker, a skill-gap sprint planner, and a confidence and momentum journal. Design direction: use a calm-consumer aesthetic with soft neutral surfaces, reassuring blue-green accents, clear guided steps, and emotionally steady framing so the product feels supportive, competent, and momentum-building rather than bleak.
